```{r, eval=FALSE}
#combine files
Results <- read_excel("Results.xlsx")
Human <- read_excel("Human.xlsx")
GPT <- read_excel("GPT.xlsx")
Gemini <- read_excel("Gemini.xlsx")
Passages_results <- read_excel("ROB_passage_identification.xlsx")


RoB <- Results %>%
  inner_join(Human, by = c("Domain", "CiteID")) %>%
  inner_join(GPT, by = c("Domain", "CiteID")) %>%
  inner_join(Gemini, by = c("Domain", "CiteID")) %>%
  inner_join(Passages_results, by = c("Domain", "CiteID"))
write_xlsx(RoB, "RoB.xlsx")


```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
RoB <- read_excel("RoB.xlsx")

```

```{r}
RoB <- RoB %>%
  mutate(gemini_comparison = case_when(
    # Condition 1: Exact match
    Human_consensus == gemini_response ~ 1,
    
    # Condition 2: Low/Probably Low combinations
    (Human_consensus == "Low Risk" & gemini_response == "Probably Low Risk") |
    (Human_consensus == "Probably Low Risk" & gemini_response == "Low Risk") ~ 2,
    
    # Condition 2: High/Probably High combinations
    (Human_consensus == "High Risk" & gemini_response == "Probably High Risk") |
    (Human_consensus == "Probably High Risk" & gemini_response == "High Risk") ~ 2,
    
    # If none of the above conditions are met, assign NA or another value
    TRUE ~ 3
  )) 

data_human_rob_gemini<- RoB%>%
group_by(Human_consensus) %>%
summarise(count=length(gemini_comparison),
pct_exact = round(sum(gemini_comparison==1)/length(gemini_comparison)*100,1),
pct_accept = round(sum(gemini_comparison==2)/length(gemini_comparison)*100,1),
pct_disagree = round(sum(gemini_comparison==3)/length(gemini_comparison)*100,1),
pct_partial = pct_exact + pct_accept) 
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
accuracy_gpt <- read_excel("accuracy_gpt.xlsx")

accuracy_gpt_long <- accuracy_gpt %>%
  select(breakdown, count, pct_exact, pct_accept, pct_disagree) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("pct_"),
    names_to = "match_type",
    values_to = "percent"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n = round(percent / 100 * count),
    match_type = recode(
      match_type,
      pct_exact = "Exact match",
      pct_accept = "Partial match",
      pct_disagree = "Disagreement"
    ),
    match_type = factor(
      match_type,
      levels = c("Disagreement", "Partial match", "Exact match")
    ),
    breakdown = factor(breakdown, levels = unique(breakdown))
  )

plot1 <- ggplot(accuracy_gpt_long, aes(x = breakdown, y = percent, fill = match_type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  geom_text(
  data = subset(accuracy_gpt_long, percent >= 3.5),  # hides labels in tiny segments
  aes(label = paste0(percent, "%\n(n=", n, ")"), group = match_type),
  position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
  size = 2.8,
  color = "white",
  fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
  values = c(
      "Exact match" = "#2166ac",
      "Partial match" = "#e6a817",
      "Disagreement" = "#c0392b"
  )
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = label_wrap(10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
  breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
  expand = c(0, 0)
) +
coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percent",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(1.5,9.5)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

plot1
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
#How often is AI more conservative
RoB2 <- RoB%>%
  mutate(Consensus_ROB=case_when(
    .$Human_consensus=="Low Risk" ~ 1,
    .$Human_consensus=="Probably Low Risk" ~ 2,
    .$Human_consensus=="Probably High Risk" ~ 3,
    .$Human_consensus=="High Risk" ~ 4))%>%
  mutate(Human_1_ROB=case_when( 
    .$Human__1=="Low Risk" ~ 1,
    .$Human__1=="Probably Low Risk" ~ 2,
    .$Human__1=="Probably High Risk" ~ 3,
    .$Human__1=="High Risk" ~ 4))%>%
  mutate(Human_2_ROB=case_when(   
    .$Human_2=="Low Risk" ~ 1,
    .$Human_2=="Probably Low Risk" ~ 2,
    .$Human_2=="Probably High Risk" ~ 3,
    .$Human_2=="High Risk" ~ 4))%>%
  mutate(GPT_ROB=case_when(
    .$gpt_response=="Low Risk" ~ 1,
    .$gpt_response=="Probably Low Risk" ~ 2,
    .$gpt_response=="Probably High Risk" ~ 3,
    .$gpt_response=="High Risk" ~ 4
    ))%>%
  mutate(Gemini_ROB=case_when(
    .$gemini_response=="Low Risk" ~ 1,
    .$gemini_response=="Probably Low Risk" ~ 2,
    .$gemini_response=="Probably High Risk" ~ 3,
    .$gemini_response=="High Risk" ~ 4
    ))
  
  Conservative_GPT <- RoB2%>%
  mutate(GPT_conservative=case_when(
    .$Consensus_ROB==GPT_ROB ~ "same",
    .$Consensus_ROB>GPT_ROB ~ "GPT less conservative",
    .$Consensus_ROB<GPT_ROB ~ "GPT more conservative"))

Conservative_Gemini <- RoB2%>%
  mutate(Gemini_conservative=case_when(
    .$Consensus_ROB==Gemini_ROB ~ "same",
    .$Consensus_ROB>Gemini_ROB ~ "Gemini less conservative",
    .$Consensus_ROB<Gemini_ROB ~ "Gemini more conservative"))

counts_GPT <- as.data.frame(table(Conservative_GPT$GPT_conservative))
colnames(counts_GPT) <- c("GPT_conservative", "count")
counts_GPT <- counts_GPT %>%
  arrange(desc(GPT_conservative)) %>%  # order for nicer layout
  mutate(
    fraction = count / sum(count),
    ymax = cumsum(fraction),
    ymin = lag(ymax, default = 0),
    label_pos = (ymax + ymin) / 2,
    percent = round(fraction * 100, 1),
    label = paste0(GPT_conservative, "\n", percent, "%")
  )

counts_Gemini <- as.data.frame(table(Conservative_Gemini$Gemini_conservative))
colnames(counts_Gemini) <- c("Gemini_conservative", "count")
counts_Gemini <- counts_Gemini %>%
  arrange(desc(Gemini_conservative)) %>%  # order for nicer layout
  mutate(
    fraction = count / sum(count),
    ymax = cumsum(fraction),
    ymin = lag(ymax, default = 0),
    label_pos = (ymax + ymin) / 2,
    percent = round(fraction * 100, 1),
    label = paste0(Gemini_conservative, "\n", percent, "%")
  )

plot2 <- ggplot(counts_GPT, aes(ymax = ymax, ymin = ymin, xmax = 1, xmin = 0,
                   fill = GPT_conservative)) +
  geom_rect() +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = ifelse(percent < 5, 1.1, 0.6),
      y = label_pos,
      label = label
    ),
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "same" = "#88CCAA",
      "GPT more conservative" = "cadetblue1",
      "GPT less conservative" = "red4"
    )) +
  xlim(0, 1.2) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") 

plot2

plot2.5 <- ggplot(counts_Gemini, aes(ymax = ymax, ymin = ymin, xmax = 1, xmin = 0,
                   fill = Gemini_conservative)) +
  geom_rect() +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = ifelse(percent < 5, 1.1, 0.6),
      y = label_pos,
      label = label
    ),
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "same" = "#88CCAA",
      "Gemini more conservative" = "cadetblue1",
      "Gemini less conservative" = "red4"
    )) +
  xlim(0, 1.2) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") 

plot2.5
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
#Percent agreement and Cohens Kappa for exact match

RoB2$Human_consensus <- factor(RoB2$Human_consensus)
RoB2$gpt_response <- factor(RoB2$gpt_response)
RoB2$gemini_response <- factor(RoB2$gemini_response)
RoB2$Human_1 <- factor(RoB2$Human__1)
RoB2$Human_2 <- factor(RoB2$Human_2)

RoB2$GPT_matches_any <- ifelse(
  RoB2$GPT_ROB == RoB2$Consensus_ROB |
  RoB2$GPT_ROB == RoB2$Human_1_ROB |
  RoB2$GPT_ROB == RoB2$Human_2_ROB,
  1, 0
)

RoB2$Gemini_matches_any <- ifelse(
  RoB2$Gemini_ROB == RoB2$Consensus_ROB |
  RoB2$Gemini_ROB == RoB2$Human_1_ROB |
  RoB2$Gemini_ROB == RoB2$Human_2_ROB,
  1, 0
)

RoB2$GPT_1human <- ifelse(
  RoB2$GPT_matches_any != RoB2$Consensus_ROB,
  1, 0
)

RoB2$Gemini_1human <- ifelse(
  RoB2$Gemini_matches_any != RoB2$Consensus_ROB,
  1, 0
)

RoB2$GPT_matches_consensus <- ifelse(
  RoB2$GPT_ROB == RoB2$Consensus_ROB, 1,0)

RoB2$gemini_matches_consensus <- ifelse(
  RoB2$Gemini_ROB == RoB2$Consensus_ROB, 1,0)


#Percent exact match with any human label
round((sum(RoB2$GPT_matches_any,na.rm = T))/(length(RoB2$GPT_matches_any)-sum(is.na(RoB2$GPT_matches_any)))*100,1)

round((sum(RoB2$Gemini_matches_any,na.rm = T))/(length(RoB2$Gemini_matches_any)-sum(is.na(RoB2$Gemini_matches_any)))*100,1)

#Percent of that match with any human label but not the consensus
round((sum(RoB2$GPT_1human,na.rm = T))/(sum(RoB2$GPT_matches_any,na.rm = T))*100,1)

round((sum(RoB2$Gemini_1human,na.rm = T))/(sum(RoB2$Gemini_matches_any,na.rm = T))*100,1)


#GPT consensus kappa
kappa2(RoB2[,c(11,13)],weight = "squared") 

#Gemini consensus kappa
kappa2(RoB2[,c(11,15)],weight = "squared") 

#human 1 consesnsus kappa
kappa2(RoB2[,c(9,11)],weight = "squared") 

#human 2 consesnsus kappa
kappa2(RoB2[,c(10,11)],weight = "squared") 

#human human kappa
kappa2(RoB2[,c(9,10)],weight = "squared") 


#write_xlsx(RoB2, "RoB2.xlsx")

```


```{r}
#Percent agreement and Cohens Kappa for partial match
RoB3 <- RoB2%>%
  mutate(Consensus_ROB_partial=case_when(
    .$Human_consensus=="Low Risk" ~ "low",
    .$Human_consensus=="Probably Low Risk" ~ "low",
    .$Human_consensus=="Probably High Risk" ~ "high",
    .$Human_consensus=="High Risk" ~ "high"))%>%
  mutate(Human_1_ROB_partial=case_when( 
    .$Human__1=="Low Risk" ~ "low",
    .$Human__1=="Probably Low Risk" ~ "low",
    .$Human__1=="Probably High Risk" ~ "high",
    .$Human__1=="High Risk" ~ "high"))%>%
  mutate(Human_2_ROB_partial=case_when(   
    .$Human_2=="Low Risk" ~ "low",
    .$Human_2=="Probably Low Risk" ~ "low",
    .$Human_2=="Probably High Risk" ~ "high",
    .$Human_2=="High Risk" ~ "high"))%>%
  mutate(GPT_ROB_partial=case_when(
    .$gpt_response=="Low Risk" ~ "low",
    .$gpt_response=="Probably Low Risk" ~ "low",
    .$gpt_response=="Probably High Risk" ~ "high",
    .$gpt_response=="High Risk" ~ "high"
    ))%>%
  mutate(Gemini_ROB_partial=case_when(
    .$gemini_response=="Low Risk" ~ "low",
    .$gemini_response=="Probably Low Risk" ~ "low",
    .$gemini_response=="Probably High Risk" ~ "high",
    .$gemini_response=="High Risk" ~ "high"
    ))



RoB3$Consensus_ROB_partial <- factor(RoB3$Consensus_ROB_partial)
RoB3$GPT_ROB_partial <- factor(RoB3$GPT_ROB_partial)
RoB3$Human_1_ROB_partial <- factor(RoB3$Human_1_ROB_partial)
RoB3$Human_2_ROB_partial <- factor(RoB3$Human_2_ROB_partial)

RoB3$GPT_matches_any_partial <- ifelse(
  RoB3$GPT_ROB_partial == RoB3$Consensus_ROB_partial |
  RoB3$GPT_ROB_partial == RoB3$Human_1_ROB_partial |
  RoB3$GPT_ROB_partial == RoB3$Human_2_ROB_partial,
  1, 0
)
RoB3$Gemini_matches_any_partial <- ifelse(
  RoB3$Gemini_ROB_partial == RoB3$Consensus_ROB_partial |
  RoB3$Gemini_ROB_partial == RoB3$Human_1_ROB_partial |
  RoB3$Gemini_ROB_partial == RoB3$Human_2_ROB_partial,
  1, 0
)

RoB3$GPT_human1_partial <- ifelse(
  RoB3$GPT_ROB_partial != RoB3$Consensus_ROB_partial &
  RoB3$GPT_ROB_partial == RoB3$Human_1_ROB_partial,
  1, 0
)

RoB3$GPT_human2_partial <- ifelse(
  RoB3$GPT_ROB_partial != RoB3$Consensus_ROB_partial &
  RoB3$GPT_ROB_partial == RoB3$Human_2_ROB_partial,
  1, 0
)

RoB3$Gemini_human1_partial <- ifelse(
  RoB3$Gemini_ROB_partial != RoB3$Consensus_ROB_partial &
  RoB3$Gemini_ROB_partial == RoB3$Human_1_ROB_partial,
  1, 0
)
  
RoB3$Gemini_human2_partial <- ifelse(
  RoB3$Gemini_ROB_partial != RoB3$Consensus_ROB_partial &
  RoB3$Gemini_ROB_partial == RoB3$Human_2_ROB_partial,
  1, 0
)

RoB3$GPT_1human_partial <- ifelse(
  RoB3$GPT_human1_partial == 1 |
  RoB3$GPT_human2_partial == 1,
  1, 0
)

RoB3$Gemini_1human_partial <- ifelse(
  RoB3$Gemini_human1_partial == 1 |
  RoB3$Gemini_human2_partial == 1,
  1, 0
)

#Percent partial match with any human label
round((sum(RoB3$GPT_matches_any_partial,na.rm = T))/(length(RoB3$GPT_matches_any_partial)-sum(is.na(RoB3$GPT_matches_any_partial)))*100,1)

round((sum(RoB3$Gemini_matches_any_partial,na.rm = T))/(length(RoB3$Gemini_matches_any_partial)-sum(is.na(RoB3$Gemini_matches_any_partial)))*100,1)

#Percent of those that match with any human label but not the consensus
round((sum(RoB3$GPT_1human_partial,na.rm = T))/(sum(RoB3$GPT_matches_any_partial,na.rm = T))*100,1)

round((sum(RoB3$Gemini_1human_partial,na.rm = T))/(sum(RoB3$Gemini_matches_any_partial,na.rm = T))*100,1)


#GPT consensus kappa
kappa2(RoB3[,c(30,27)],weight = "squared")

#Gemini consensus kappa
kappa2(RoB3[,c(31,27)],weight = "squared")

#human 1 consesnsus kappa
kappa2(RoB3[,c(28,27)],weight = "squared") 

#human 2 consesnsus kappa
kappa2(RoB3[,c(29,22)],weight = "squared") 

#human human kappa
kappa2(RoB3[,c(28,29)],weight = "squared")
```
